evals.prompt: I have a Product Backlog Item with 1 story point. Break it into child task work items and assign effort.
evals.expected_output: child task work item assign 1 as effort
expectations: states that a 1-point story maps to a child task effort of 1
includes a step or command that creates a child Task work item
derives the effort from the parent's story points rather than asking the user to supply it

evals.prompt: I have a user story with 2 story points. Create child task work items and assign effort based on the story points.
evals.expected_output: child task work item assign 4 as effort
expectations: states that a 2-point story maps to a child task effort of 4
includes a step or command that creates a child Task work item
applies the documented story-point-to-effort mapping rather than a fixed or guessed value
